title: Java method-region live-out facts need UI tree-consumption classification
wanted_capability: For Java UI builder extraction gates, classify locals declared in a candidate block that are consumed by component-tree wiring inside the same block separately from true post-block live-outs. Method return values should also be identifiable as a special live-out case instead of blindly tripping multi-live-out refusal.
missing_primitive: UI/component-tree aware live-out classification for Java methodRegions/extract gates
fallback_used: Probe selected a smaller block with zero live-outs instead of the broader stage that appeared to require multiple outputs.
resolution_note: Addressed by adding live-out enrichment to analysis.methodRegions: live_outs now carry after_use_kinds plus component_tree_consumptions for in-region UI/component-tree wiring, with tests covering return-value and component-tree receiver/argument cases.
